## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Crafted, see below.

## Crafting

**Made by**

- On the ground with a [Screwdriver](Screwdriver) (kept), 20 s: [Gas Cylinder](Gas-Cylinder) + [Fluctuator Unit](Fluctuator-Unit) + [Power Supply](Power-Supply) + [Receiver](Receiver); taken down again with a [Crowbar](Crowbar) in 30 s, which gives the parts back

## Scrap

Cannot be scrapped: a Scrap Machine destroys it, see [Scrap](Scrap).
